document_title: Card and ACH Dispute Handling Procedure
heading: Apply provisional credit
text: On day 7 after the notice, if the case is open, the analyst applies provisional credit and logs the case in the aging report.

document_title: Card and ACH Dispute Handling Procedure
heading: Send the provisional credit letter
text: Letter template DL-04 is sent within 2 business days of the credit.

heading: Changed circumstances
text: Processors issue a revised Loan Estimate within 5 business days of a documented changed circumstance.

heading: Grant privileged access
text: Privileged accounts are enrolled in the bank's authenticator app before activation.
